note: Scope and ceiling for LI-Small, on its own terms. NOT comparable to HI-Small's ring_scope.json as a single number -- different base rate, ring count and day structure. The HI-Small column is printed only so a reader compares like with like.

tail_pathology.reading: LI-Small's test tail collapses exactly as HI-Small's does: days 10+ hold 3-77 edges each at a 56-71 % base rate, against 0.04-0.11 % on days 8-9. The primary window is therefore defined the same way (days 8-9) and the tail reported separately, for the same reason and with the same rule.

decision.rule: docs/GENERALISATION.md pre-registration: if too few rings survive scope and min_size for a CI to separate anything, report feasibility + scope only.
decision.outcome: STOP after the scope/tail analysis. Neither the L3 grid NOR B0 is run on LI-Small.
decision.reason: 38 matchable rings in the primary window (against HI-Small's 114) cannot separate B0 from full at any effect size this pipeline produces; a bootstrap over 38 rings has a half-width wider than the whole B0->full gain measured on HI-Small. Running the grid would produce a number, not evidence.
decision.revision_note: Originally 'stop at B0 + scope/tail'. Revised on the same reasoning taken one step further: B0 on LI-Small would require training its detector (~20 h for 5 seeds at 6.9 M edges) to produce a ring-level number over 38 matchable rings that nobody should interpret. The scope, tail and day-0 results are the reportable outcome and none of them need a detector. The compute goes to 11d (chain-mode expansion) and the MEGA partition test, both of which target measured losses on a dataset with enough rings to resolve them.
what_is_reported: the pipeline runs unchanged on a second release via one environment variable
LI-Small scope table and ceiling on its own terms
the tail collapse reproduces (FINDINGS C1 becomes generator-level)
the day-0 warm-up reproduces to within 0.3 points (FINDINGS C8)
decision.what_is_not_reported: any LI-Small method number; if one is ever produced it is labelled illustrative and given no CI-based claim.
